source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to DM-Ad if its same rule as salesuk.js: first-session utm_campaign exactly matches (or is a prefixed variant of) "Shop_DM_PMax-46_AguAsset" or "Shop_DM_PMax-46", OR utm_campaign is "sag_organic", OR (first session has no campaign/term AND the LAST session's campaign is "Shop_DM_PMax-46_AguAsset") (case-insensitive).. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Kamsi -> Dilaksi -> Organic) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. 2025 backfill using the exact same rules already confirmed on salesuk.html for 2026 — built 2026-07-29.
